metadata.title: Historical jackpot six-number types and per-combination probability exploration

source.sourceName: Donghaeng Lottery official public draw-result API
source.sourceMethod: GET; srchDir=center&srchLtEpsd=latest followed by srchDir=older&srchCursorLtEpsd=oldest. Endpoint and parameter names read from official result-page JavaScript.

specification.drawWeight: Each of522draws contributes exactly1; firstPrizeWinners and prize amounts are never used as weights.

partitions.definition: count i=0..4 where sorted[i+1]-sorted[i]==1; no wraparound
number of distinct decimal residues n%10
partitions.categories: 1..6; zero-cardinality categories retained and marked impossible
five-component nonnegative count vectors summing to6, last count<=5

partitions.definition: Cartesian product of fixed sum_bin,odd_count,adjacent_pairs categories; impossible cells retained
Cartesian product of fixed sum_bin,odd_count,low_count categories; impossible cells retained

rollingModel.noPeek: prediction at index t uses only draws[max(0,t-156)..t-1]

mixture.probability: arithmetic mean of11normalized unordered-ticket probabilities; never averaged feature scores

specification.selection: Highest development mean exact joint loggain including uniform; ties follow model order; no retuning after results.
specification.primaryMetric: log(8145060*P(actual unordered six-number set)), natural logarithms

descriptive.observedRateInterval: Wilson95%, descriptive unadjusted interval, not future prediction interval

specification.forecastUncertaintyWidths: Show Wilson95 observed-rate intervals and widths for trailing156counts as descriptive uncertainty only; do not call them guaranteed future-ticket probability intervals.

fiveDistinctTicketsInSameCategory.qualification: Exact only under stated fitted type model, not a verified change in fair-draw chances.

limitations: Last104draws were used in earlier analyses and are exploratory reused history, not an untouched test.
Category selection and all partitions fixed before this experiment's scores; no tuning after results.
Large class frequency does not imply large probability for an individual combination because its cardinalityNc also matters.
For a fair independent draw exact class probability is qc and every individual ticket probability is1/8145060.
Wilson intervals, lifts, and their display ranking are descriptive exploratory summaries with no multiplicity adjustment.
Adjusted bootstrap intervals are approximate and do not remove historical reuse or post-selection effects.

descriptive.method: Each draw once. Historical count and rate, exact fair expectation, observed/fair lift, unadjusted Wilson95 observed-rate interval.

latestForecast.interpretation: Modeled category and per-ticket probabilities are experimental estimates, not verified future lottery chances. Under a fair independent draw category probability is exactly Nc/N and ticket probability is1/N.

limitations: Last104draws were used in earlier analyses and are exploratory reused history, not an untouched test.
Category selection and all partitions fixed before this experiment's scores; no tuning after results.
Large class frequency does not imply large probability for an individual combination because its cardinalityNc also matters.
For a fair independent draw exact class probability is qc and every individual ticket probability is1/8145060.
Wilson intervals, lifts, and their display ranking are descriptive exploratory summaries with no multiplicity adjustment.
Adjusted bootstrap intervals are approximate and do not remove historical reuse or post-selection effects.
